title: HFS Codex Final Implementation Review
description: Structured verdict produced by Codex at Stop time, comparing the accepted plan against the actual implementation (git diff + test evidence) for the Helios HFS backend.

decision.description: pass only if the implementation fully satisfies the accepted plan (or explicitly justifies any no-longer-needed item); otherwise fail.

workflow_type.description: Primary HFS work domain the implementation targets, derived from the accepted plan and final diff.

summary.description: One or two sentences summarizing the implementation and the basis for the decision.

checklist.description: Universal checklist applied to every HFS implementation review. Every field must be true for a pass.

all_plan_items_addressed.description: Every accepted plan item is implemented or explicitly justified as unnecessary. An item that can only be completed remotely (e.g. enabling/triggering a GitHub Actions workflow) counts as addressed once its local artifacts are present in the diff; never mark it missing for lack of a remote CI run.

implementation_matches_plan.description: The diff and transcript evidence match the accepted plan's intended approach.

constraints_respected.description: User constraints and accepted-plan constraints are followed in the implementation.

no_unrelated_risky_changes.description: The diff contains no unrelated or risky changes outside the plan.

tests_or_verification_performed.description: Concrete test/check/manual verification evidence is present - local runs (fmt/clippy/affected cargo test) or the change wired to/covered by a named CI workflow. CI-deferred verification counts even if the workflow has not run yet or must be enabled remotely first; absence of a remote CI run is never a deficiency.

final_summary_accurate.description: Claude's final message accurately reports changes, checks run, and any residual failures.

required_checks_performed.description: The mandatory developer gate was actually run for the code changes: cargo fmt --all, CI clippy (--all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings), and an affected cargo test; plus pysof's uv run pytest python-tests/ and cargo test when crates/pysof changed. Judge from the provided .claude/state/policy.env (FMT_OK/CLIPPY_OK/TEST_OK) and transcript evidence. True if such checks are genuinely unnecessary (e.g. docs-only) and that is justified.

ci_coverage_addressed.description: The change is covered by an existing GitHub Actions workflow (ci.yml lint/test-rust/coverage/security/test-python/test-fhirpath/hts-conformance, ci-extended, or the Inferno/smoke/HTS conformance suites), a workflow was added/updated in the diff, or the plan defers it to a named workflow - true in all these cases even if the workflow has not executed yet or must first be added/enabled remotely. True if CI coverage is genuinely unaffected and that is justified. Never fail because heavy integration/conformance tests run in CI rather than locally, because a CI job has not run, or because a new workflow cannot be exercised locally; only fail on a real CI gap that the plan neither covers nor justifies.

fhir_version_impact_handled.description: FHIR version gating is implemented across the affected R4/R4B/R5/R6 features as planned (version-agnostic enum wrappers and feature flags consistent), or FHIR versioning genuinely does not apply.

crate_boundaries_correct.description: Changes landed in the correct workspace crate(s) for the work performed.

reuse_over_duplication.description: The diff reuses existing workspace traits, enums, structs, functions, and helpers rather than duplicating or copy-pasting logic that already exists; verified against the actual codebase (search for an existing type/trait/helper before accepting a new one). No parallel re-implementation of an existing abstraction (e.g. version-agnostic enum wrappers, the storage trait hierarchy, shared serde/support utilities). Any genuinely new abstraction is justified. True when the change is small/isolated enough that no meaningful reuse opportunity applies.

completed_items.description: Accepted-plan items confirmed implemented in the diff/evidence.

violations.description: Every constraint or plan violation found in the implementation.

missing_tests_or_verification.description: Every missing or weak check (local or CI).

inaccurate_summary_points.description: Every inaccurate or omitted point in Claude's final summary.

test_evidence.description: Concrete evidence of checks/tests performed (commands run, CI workflows that cover the change, observed results).

required_next_steps.description: When decision is fail, concrete corrective actions Claude must take before stopping.

server_api_checklist.description: REST/Axum implementation in helios-rest. Must be fully true when workflow_type is server_api.

handler_and_route_registration_implement.description: Handler (crates/rest/src/handlers/) and route registration (crates/rest/src/routes.rs) are implemented in the diff.

request_response_contract_correct.description: Request/response handling is correct: extractors, content negotiation, compression, and payload shapes.

operation_outcome_error_paths_handled.description: Error and permission paths return FHIR OperationOutcome with correct HTTP status codes.

endpoint_tests_evidenced.description: Endpoint-level test evidence is present: a local run, or a named/added covering CI workflow (which need not have executed remotely yet).

persistence_checklist.description: Storage/persistence implementation in helios-persistence. Must be fully true when workflow_type is persistence.

tenant_context_first_and_isolation_prese.description: Storage operations take TenantContext as the first argument and enforce tenant boundaries at the query level in the implementation.

trait_hierarchy_and_capabilities_correct.description: The storage trait hierarchy is respected (ResourceStorage -> VersionedStorage / SearchProvider / TransactionProvider); new backends advertise via CapabilityProvider.

backend_compatibility_and_migration_hand.description: Compatibility/migration across affected backends (SQLite/PostgreSQL/Elasticsearch/MongoDB/composite) is handled.

persistence_integration_tests_evidenced.description: Integration test evidence is present: testcontainers-based locally, or a named/added covering CI workflow (which need not have executed remotely yet).

fhir_core_checklist.description: FHIR data model / serde / fhirpath / sof implementation. Must be fully true when workflow_type is fhir_core.

fhir_version_coverage_implemented.description: Coverage across the affected R4/R4B/R5/R6 feature flags is implemented, or a single-version scope is justified.

version_agnostic_abstraction_preserved.description: Version-agnostic enum wrappers (e.g. SofViewDefinition) and traits are preserved in the implementation.

serde_or_codegen_consistent.description: helios-serde and generated code (fhir-gen) remain consistent with the changes.

fhir_conformance_tests_evidenced.description: FHIRPath/SOF conformance test evidence is present: a local run, or a named/added covering CI workflow (which need not have executed remotely yet).

tooling_config_checklist.description: Hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md, CI, scripts, settings implementation. Must be fully true when workflow_type is tooling_config.

config_or_docs_changes_complete.description: Config/docs changes are complete (settings.json, hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md, CI).

hook_or_workflow_compatibility_preserved.description: Change does not break existing hooks (e.g. hfs-policy.sh stop-gate) and respects interpreter availability (jq/python3).

apply_or_reload_evidenced.description: How the change is applied/activated is evidenced (e.g. restart session to reload settings).

verification_command_evidenced.description: A concrete verification command was run or named.

server_api_issues.description: Missing or broken API/interface contract, handler/route registration, error/permission path, or endpoint test evidence.

persistence_issues.description: Missing tenant isolation, trait/capability correctness, backend compatibility/migration, or integration test evidence.

fhir_core_issues.description: Missing FHIR version coverage, version-agnostic abstraction, serde/codegen consistency, or conformance test evidence.

tooling_config_issues.description: Missing config/docs change, hook/workflow compatibility, apply/reload behavior, or verification evidence.

subscriptions_checklist.description: FHIR Subscriptions implementation in helios-subscriptions. Must be fully true when workflow_type is subscriptions.

topic_and_event_matching_implemented.description: SubscriptionTopic criteria and resource-event evaluation/filter matching are implemented (evaluator, topics).

channel_delivery_implemented.description: Delivery channel(s) — rest-hook, websocket, email, messaging — and notification bundle building reuse the existing SubscriptionEngine/channels rather than ad-hoc delivery.

endpoint_safety_and_retry_handled.description: Endpoint safety (private/loopback policy, HFS_SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS) and delivery retry/backoff are handled.

subscription_tests_evidenced.description: Test evidence is present: local tests or a named/added covering workflow (inferno-subscription / subscriptions-channels / subscriptions-smoke), which need not have executed remotely yet.

subscriptions_issues.description: Missing or broken topic/event matching, channel delivery, endpoint-safety/retry handling, or subscription test evidence.
